opennyai_summary.facts:
01. The petitioners are the owners with respect to their land with respect to which an acquisition exercise came to be initiated way back in year 2011 under the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 only to be concluded in the form of issuance of two awards i.e. Award no.
5142-44/Acq dated 03.01.2011 & Award no. 1326-28/Acq dated 25.02.2021 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Doda.
02. The petitioners are aggrieved that the entire exercise so conducted by the Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Doda is illegal and it ought to have been under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

Registrar Judicial, Jammu shall be entitled to extend time for furnishing of registered postal covers if not submitted within time given.
In the meantime, petitioners shall be entitled to seek withdrawal of the compensation so assessed under the impugned award and withdrawal of compensation by the petitioners shall not be causing any prejudice to this writ petition.
09. It is made clear that the Indenting Department shall make available the requisite funds meant for the payment of compensation of the acquired land with the Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Doda, failing which the officers concerned at the end of the Indenting Department shall be held liable for the payment of interests/additional costs for delay in payment of the compensation.
